```{r global-collection}
# Characterization of a global collection of publicly available Neisseria gonorrhoeae genomes

collection_year_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  summarise(
    genomes_with_year = sum(!is.na(collection_year)),
    genomes_in_2010s = sum(collection_decade == 2010, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_in_2010s = 100 * mean(collection_decade == 2010, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_year = median(collection_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_q1 = unname(quantile(collection_year, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    year_q3 = unname(quantile(collection_year, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_year = sum(is.na(collection_year))
  )

continent_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_continent)) %>%
  count(collection_continent, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

country_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_country), collection_country != "Unknown") %>%
  count(collection_country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent_all_genomes = 100 * n / nrow(pathogenwatch_isolate_data))

sequence_type_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence_type)) %>%
  count(sequence_type, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

resistance_summary <- summarise_resistance(
  pathogenwatch_isolate_data,
  isolate_column = "genome_id",
  resistance_levels = c("RESISTANT", "INTERMEDIATE", "NOT_FOUND"),
  resistance_columns = resistance_variables
) %>%
  filter(value != "NOT_FOUND") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), percent = sum(perc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(variable = as.character(variable)) %>%
  arrange(match(variable, resistance_variables))

raw_mutation_variables <- setdiff(
  colnames(ng_meta),
  c("Isolate", "Genome Name.y", resistance_variables)
)

nrow(pathogenwatch_isolate_data) # genomes in the global collection
n_distinct(na.omit(ng_sample_metadata$`Collection label`)) # Pathogenwatch collections
collection_year_summary # collection-year distribution, including the 2010s and missing years
sum(!is.na(pathogenwatch_isolate_data$collection_continent)) # genomes with location metadata
continent_summary # continent distribution among genomes with location metadata
nrow(country_summary) # represented countries
slice_head(country_summary, n = 5) # five largest country contributors
nrow(sequence_type_summary) # sequence types
slice_head(sequence_type_summary, n = 5) # five most abundant sequence types
resistance_summary # predicted non-susceptibility for eight antibiotics
length(raw_mutation_variables) # resistance-associated mutations
n_distinct(sub("_.*", "", raw_mutation_variables)) # resistance-associated loci
ng_meta %>% select(all_of(c(resistance_variables, raw_mutation_variables))) %>% distinct() %>% nrow() # distinct raw genotype and resistance patterns
pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>% select(all_of(c(resistance_variables, mutation_variables))) %>% distinct() %>% nrow() # distinct gene-grouped genotype and resistance patterns
```

```{r representative-sample}
# Generation of a representative sample of publicly available isolates to inform probe design

threshold_cluster_summary <- threshold_profiles %>%
  mutate(across(-genome_id, as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -genome_id,
    names_to = "threshold",
    values_to = "profile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = as.integer(threshold),
    aa_cluster = sub("[.].*$", "", profile)
  ) %>%
  count(threshold, aa_cluster, name = "cluster_size") %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    multi_genome_clusters = sum(cluster_size > 1),
    genomes_in_multi_genome_clusters = sum(cluster_size[cluster_size > 1]),
    singleton_groups = sum(cluster_size == 1),
    total_aa_groups = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

aa_group_sizes <- profile_assignments %>%
  count(aa_cluster, name = "group_size") %>%
  transmute(grouping = "350-AA groups", group_size)

partitioned_group_sizes <- profile_assignments %>%
  count(profile, name = "group_size") %>%
  transmute(grouping = "Genotype- and resistance-partitioned groups", group_size)

group_size_summary <- bind_rows(
  aa_group_sizes,
  partitioned_group_sizes
) %>%
  group_by(grouping) %>%
  summarise(
    groups = n(),
    singleton_groups = sum(group_size == 1),
    multi_genome_groups = sum(group_size > 1),
    median_size = median(group_size),
    size_q1 = unname(quantile(group_size, 0.25)),
    size_q3 = unname(quantile(group_size, 0.75)),
    maximum_size = max(group_size),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nrow(profile_assignments) # genomes assigned to amino acid clusters
threshold_cluster_summary %>% filter(singleton_groups == 0) %>% slice_min(threshold, n = 1) # first threshold with every genome in a multi-genome cluster
threshold_cluster_summary %>% filter(threshold == 350) # 350-amino acid distance clusters and singleton groups
n_distinct(profile_assignments$profile) # genotype- and resistance-partitioned groups
length(chosen_genome_ids) # representative genomes selected for probe design
group_size_summary # group sizes before and after genotype and resistance partitioning
```

```{r chosen-comparison}
# Chosen assemblies capture genotype distributions despite shifting lineage compositions

overall_data <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  mutate(study = "Overall")

chosen_data <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(is_chosen) %>%
  mutate(study = "Chosen")

comparison_data <- bind_rows(overall_data, chosen_data)

temporal_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_decade)) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(
    genomes_with_year = n(),
    genomes_in_2010s = sum(collection_decade == 2010),
    percent_in_2010s = 100 * mean(collection_decade == 2010),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

set.seed(45)
decade_fisher_p <- fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$collection_decade, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value

continent_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_continent)) %>%
  count(study, collection_continent) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percent = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sequence_type_comparison <- tibble(
  global_sequence_types = n_distinct(overall_data$sequence_type, na.rm = TRUE),
  chosen_sequence_types = n_distinct(chosen_data$sequence_type, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(percent_represented = 100 * chosen_sequence_types / global_sequence_types)

set.seed(45)
sequence_type_fisher_p <- fisher.test(
  table(comparison_data$sequence_type, comparison_data$study),
  simulate.p.value = TRUE
)$p.value

resistance_distribution <- comparison_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(resistance_variables),
    names_to = "antibiotic",
    values_to = "prediction"
  ) %>%
  group_by(antibiotic, study) %>%
  summarise(
    nonsusceptible = sum(prediction != "NOT_FOUND"),
    total = n(),
    percent = 100 * mean(prediction != "NOT_FOUND"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

resistance_p_values <- map_dfr(
  resistance_variables,
  function(antibiotic) {
    nonsusceptible <- comparison_data[[antibiotic]] != "NOT_FOUND"
    tibble(
      antibiotic = antibiotic,
      fisher_p = fisher.test(
        table(nonsusceptible, comparison_data$study)
      )$p.value
    )
  }
)

resistance_comparison <- resistance_distribution %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = study,
    values_from = c(nonsusceptible, total, percent)
  ) %>%
  left_join(resistance_p_values, by = "antibiotic") %>%
  arrange(match(antibiotic, resistance_variables))

mutation_distribution <- comparison_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(mutation_variables),
    names_to = "locus",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(present = as.numeric(as.character(value)) > 0) %>%
  group_by(locus, study) %>%
  summarise(
    present = sum(present),
    total = n(),
    percent = 100 * mean(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mutation_p_values <- map_dfr(
  mutation_variables,
  function(locus) {
    present <- as.numeric(as.character(comparison_data[[locus]])) > 0
    tibble(
      locus = locus,
      fisher_p = fisher.test(
        table(present, comparison_data$study)
      )$p.value
    )
  }
)

mutation_comparison <- mutation_distribution %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = study,
    values_from = c(present, total, percent)
  ) %>%
  left_join(mutation_p_values, by = "locus") %>%
  arrange(fisher_p)

temporal_comparison # genomes collected during the 2010s in the chosen and overall collections
decade_fisher_p # Fisher exact test for collection decade
continent_comparison # continent representation in the chosen and overall collections
sequence_type_comparison # sequence types retained in the chosen collection
sequence_type_fisher_p # Fisher exact test for sequence type distribution
resistance_comparison # non-susceptibility in the chosen and overall collections with Fisher exact tests
mutation_comparison # resistance-associated loci in the chosen and overall collections with Fisher exact tests
mutation_p_values %>% summarise(loci = n(), p_below_0_05 = sum(fisher_p < 0.05), p_below_0_001 = sum(fisher_p < 0.001)) # loci with differing genotype distributions
```

```{r clinical-specimens}
# Probe capture sequencing recovers Neisseria gonorrhoeae genetic material from clinical specimens

sample_pool_summary <- qcd_data %>%
  count(pool_level, name = "specimens")

read_count_summary <- qcd_data %>%
  summarise(
    initial_reads = sum(initial_total_reads),
    after_trimming = sum(after_trimming_reads),
    after_human_removal = sum(after_human_removal_reads),
    pathogen_mapped = sum(bowtie2_mapped_reads)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "stage", values_to = "reads")

read_reduction_summary <- qcd_data %>%
  summarise(
    specimens_with_fewer_reads_after_trimming = sum(
      after_trimming_reads < initial_total_reads
    ),
    specimens_with_fewer_reads_after_human_removal = sum(
      after_human_removal_reads < after_trimming_reads
    ),
    specimens_with_fewer_pathogen_mapped_reads = sum(
      bowtie2_mapped_reads < after_human_removal_reads
    ),
    total_specimens = n()
  )

ng_abundance_change <- ng_abund_initial %>%
  transmute(
    sample,
    initial_relative_abundance = relative_abundance
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    qcd_data %>%
      select(
        sample,
        post_capture_relative_abundance = post_map_relative_abundance_1
      ),
    by = "sample"
  )

post_capture_abundance_summary <- qcd_data %>%
  summarise(
    median_percent = median(post_map_relative_abundance_1),
    q1_percent = unname(quantile(post_map_relative_abundance_1, 0.25)),
    q3_percent = unname(quantile(post_map_relative_abundance_1, 0.75))
  )

reference_coverage_by_pool <- reference_coverage_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("coverage_"),
    names_to = "depth_threshold",
    names_prefix = "coverage_",
    values_to = "genome_coverage_percent"
  ) %>%
  group_by(pool_level, depth_threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    median_percent = median(genome_coverage_percent),
    minimum_percent = min(genome_coverage_percent),
    maximum_percent = max(genome_coverage_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assembly_qc_by_pool <- qcd_data %>%
  group_by(pool_level) %>%
  summarise(
    passing_assemblies = sum(qc_passing),
    total_assemblies = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

passing_mlst <- mlst_data %>%
  filter(sample %in% qcd_data_passing$sample)

clinical_sequence_type_summary <- passing_mlst %>%
  summarise(
    assemblies = n(),
    typed_assemblies = sum(!is.na(ST) & ST != "-"),
    distinct_sequence_types = n_distinct(ST[!is.na(ST) & ST != "-"]),
    unassigned_assemblies = sum(is.na(ST) | ST == "-")
  )

detected_amrsearch_genotypes <- amrsearch_gene_data %>%
  filter(isolate %in% isolates) %>%
  distinct(genotype_name, entry) %>%
  arrange(entry, genotype_name)

amrsearch_edge_data <- add_contig_edge_distances(amrsearch_contig_data)

amrsearch_contig_summary <- amrsearch_edge_data %>%
  summarise(
    calls = n(),
    median_contig_bp = median(length),
    contig_q1_bp = unname(quantile(length, 0.25)),
    contig_q3_bp = unname(quantile(length, 0.75)),
    contig_iqr_bp = IQR(length),
    calls_under_10_kbp = sum(length < 10000),
    calls_under_10_kbp_percent = 100 * mean(length < 10000)
  )

amrsearch_edge_summary <- amrsearch_edge_data %>%
  summarise(
    calls = n(),
    median_edge_distance_bp = median(min_dist_to_edge),
    edge_distance_q1_bp = unname(quantile(min_dist_to_edge, 0.25)),
    edge_distance_q3_bp = unname(quantile(min_dist_to_edge, 0.75)),
    edge_distance_iqr_bp = IQR(min_dist_to_edge),
    calls_under_1_kbp = sum(min_dist_to_edge < 1000),
    calls_under_1_kbp_percent = 100 * mean(min_dist_to_edge < 1000)
  )

locus_position_coverage <- coverage_qc %>%
  group_by(locus, locus_position) %>%
  summarise(
    isolates_with_coverage = sum(depth > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

locus_coverage_summary <- locus_position_coverage %>%
  summarise(
    loci = n_distinct(locus),
    locus_positions = n(),
    positions_with_coverage = sum(isolates_with_coverage > 0),
    positions_with_coverage_percent = 100 * mean(isolates_with_coverage > 0)
  )

mutation_position_coverage <- mutation_positions %>%
  left_join(
    locus_position_coverage,
    by = c("locus", "locus_position")
  )

mutation_isolate_coverage <- coverage_qc %>%
  inner_join(
    mutation_positions,
    by = c("locus", "locus_position"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

mutation_coverage_summary <- mutation_position_coverage %>%
  summarise(
    database_positions = n(),
    positions_covered_in_at_least_one_isolate = sum(isolates_with_coverage > 0),
    positions_covered_in_all_isolates = sum(isolates_with_coverage == length(isolates))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_position_observations = nrow(mutation_isolate_coverage),
    isolate_position_observations_with_coverage = sum(
      mutation_isolate_coverage$depth > 0
    ),
    isolate_position_observations_with_coverage_percent =
      100 * mean(mutation_isolate_coverage$depth > 0)
  )

called_locus_coverage_20x <- coverage_breadth_data %>%
  filter(depth_threshold == 20) %>%
  semi_join(gene_calls, by = c("isolate", "locus")) %>%
  summarise(
    isolate_locus_pairs_at_least_90_percent = sum(percent_coverage >= 90),
    called_isolate_locus_pairs = n(),
    percent_at_least_90_percent = 100 * mean(percent_coverage >= 90)
  )

nrow(qcd_data) # clinical urine specimens
sample_pool_summary # specimens in low-, medium-, and high-abundance pools
range(probe_data$enrichment) # qPCR fold enrichment
read_count_summary # read totals before and after trimming, human-read removal, and pathogen mapping
read_reduction_summary # specimens losing reads at each processing stage
ng_abundance_change %>% summarise(increased = sum(post_capture_relative_abundance > initial_relative_abundance), total = n()) # specimens with increased Neisseria gonorrhoeae relative abundance
post_capture_abundance_summary # post-capture Neisseria gonorrhoeae relative abundance
reference_coverage_by_pool # genome coverage across read-depth thresholds and abundance pools
qcd_data %>% summarise(passing_assemblies = sum(qc_passing), total_assemblies = n()) # assemblies approaching the expected genome size
assembly_qc_by_pool # assemblies approaching the expected genome size by abundance pool
clinical_sequence_type_summary # assigned and unassigned sequence types among passing assemblies
detected_amrsearch_genotypes # resistance-associated genes and variants detected with AMRSearch
amrsearch_contig_summary # AMRSearch genotype-harboring contig sizes
amrsearch_edge_summary # AMRSearch genotype distance from contig edges
locus_coverage_summary # Pathogenwatch locus positions with read coverage
mutation_coverage_summary # Pathogenwatch database positions with read coverage
called_locus_coverage_20x # AMRSearch-called isolate-locus pairs with at least 90 percent breadth at 20x
```
